items.title: No-Filter 'Kriminal' AI Platform Raises Cybercrime Concerns
items.summary: The AI company officially forbids illicit use, while offering guardrail-free social engineering, offensive cybercrime, and OSINT scanning to anyone with a bit of cryptocurrency.

items.title: Agentic AI Presents New Insider Threat Model for Orgs
items.summary: Katie Moussouris of Luta Security talks with the Dark Reading News Desk about how enterprises will now need to monitor risks posed by their own agents in the wake of the recent Hugging Face attack.

items.title: SilkParasite Threatens Central Asian Orgs With Flurry of RATs
items.summary: A spear-phishing campaign by a China-nexus group linked to FamousSparrow provides insight into geopolitical, technical, and strategic global moves by the country's APTs.

items.title: China-Linked Hacker Shows AI Capabilities in APAC Attack
items.summary: In the first purported "near-autonomous" attack on a nation-state, a Chinese-language operator used a complex AI framework to target and compromise government agencies, likely in Taiwan.

items.title: Critical GitLab Zero-Click Flaw Poses Mitigation Challenges
items.summary: A lack of technical details could make it hard for organizations running self-managed GitLab versions to detect potential exploitation of CVE-2026-19478.

items.title: 'CoSnitch' Attack Tricked Copilot Into Mapping Out Architecture
items.summary: Researchers discovered a "meta-hacking" technique that can manipulate the AI service into revealing its own security weaknesses.

items.title: The 'Industrial Accidents' Behind Rogue AI Agent Attacks — and the Sandbox Failures Exposed
items.summary: Rich Mogull, chief analyst with the Cloud Security Alliance, joins the Dark Reading News Desk with what defenders need to take away from AI agents escaping their environments to launch attacks.

items.title: CISOs Break Their Silence in 'Declassified' Docuseries
items.summary: Million-dollar heists, divorce, and career-ending burnout are all stories told in the latest docuseries revealing a behind-the-scenes look at the cybersecurity community.

items.title: Silent 'TwinLoot' Cyber Threat Operates Entirely From Microsoft's Cloud
items.summary: The Python-based malware framework takes living-off-the-land tactics to a new heights of stealth, with a modular implant that steals credentials and achieves persistence.

items.title: 'Ransom Busters': Ransomware Actor Poses as Incident-Recovery Service
items.summary: A ransomware affiliate appears to be sidling up to victims with offers of aid, masking its true intention of diverting ransom payments.

items.title: Video Call Exploit Chains Two Flaws in Unisoc Modems
items.summary: Researchers found that by combining two vulnerabilities, they could take over an Android device by delivering a payload and getting the victim to answer their phone.

items.title: 'Turf War' Between Claude Agents Leads to Self-Replicating Malware
items.summary: Three testing models with the same goal but different directives engaged in "increasingly aggressive" territorial attacks on one another, according to Anthropic.

items.title: Hugging Face Breach Raises Big Questions About AI Security Controls
items.summary: Adam Shostack, president of Shostack & Associates and an affiliate professor at the University of Washington, talks with the Dark Reading News Desk about why he was "blown away" by OpenAI's revelations regarding the Hugging Face attack.

items.title: Linux Botnet Evooo1Bot Expands Mirai Capabilities Well Beyond DDoS
items.summary: The botnet adds exploitation modules, credential theft, and reverse SOCKS relays to turn compromised devices into persistent attacker infrastructure.
